_meta.verification_method: curl -sL -r 0-1023 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}' <example_url>; 200/206 with the expected content type counts as verified. 401 on an API endpoint without a key confirms the endpoint exists.
_meta.pin_versions: All @latest URLs were verified on 10.11.2026. For reproducible renders pin an exact version (e.g. lucide-static@1.71.0) and vendor the downloaded file.

universal_icon_fallback.name: Iconify API
universal_icon_fallback.notes: One URL pattern for 200+ sets (lucide, ph, tabler, heroicons, iconoir, ri, material-symbols, bi, simple-icons, twemoji, noto, fluent-emoji, openmoji...). The API is MIT-licensed tooling; each icon keeps its own set's license, which /collections reports as SPDX. Filter on that field to enforce the license rules automatically (reject CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-NC etc).

icons.name: Lucide
icons.notes: Best default. stroke='currentColor' and stroke-width are attributes, so recoloring and stroke-draw animation (stroke-dasharray) are trivial. A few icons derived from Feather are MIT; ISC and MIT both permit everything. Also on unpkg: https://unpkg.com/lucide-static@latest/icons/rocket.svg (verified 200).

icons.name: Phosphor
icons.fetch: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@phosphor-icons/core@<version>/assets/<weight>/<name>[-<weight>].svg  (weights: thin, light, regular, bold, fill, duotone; non-regular files carry a suffix, e.g. assets/duotone/rocket-duotone.svg)
icons.style: 6 weights incl. filled and duotone (~1512 glyphs x 6)
icons.notes: Best when one icon must appear in several weights or duotone. Duotone uses an opacity-0.2 secondary layer, easy to recolor.

icons.name: Tabler Icons
icons.notes: Largest consistent outline set. Not every outline icon has a filled twin (filled/rocket.svg is 404, filled/heart.svg is 206).

icons.name: Heroicons
icons.notes: Small (~320 glyphs x 4 variants) but very polished; Tailwind look.

icons.name: Remix Icon
icons.license: Remix Icon License v1.0 (custom, since Jan 2026; npm package.json still says Apache-2.0)
icons.redistribution_allowed: Only as part of a larger work; not as a standalone icon pack
icons.fetch: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@<version>/icons/<Category>/<name>-<line|fill>.svg (category folder required, e.g. Map, System, Business)
icons.notes: Category folder in the path makes name-only lookup awkward; Iconify (api.iconify.design/ri/rocket-line.svg) avoids it. LICENSE CHANGE: since v4.x/Jan 2026 the repo uses the custom 'Remix Icon License v1.0'. It allows commercial use with optional credit, but forbids standalone icon sales, building a competing icon library, and using an icon as a logo/brand mark. Use in a video is fine; do not vendor the full set into a public skill repo as an icon collection. Iconify still reports Apache-2.0 (older versions).

icons.name: Material Symbols
icons.notes: Biggest set; Google/Android look. Package is community-built from Google's sources.

emoji.name: OpenMoji

fonts.fetch_pattern: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/<fontsource_id>@latest/<subset>-<weight>-<normal|italic>.ttf  (subset 'latin' covers æ ø å Æ Ø Å; use 'latin-ext' for other European diacritics; .woff2 and .woff also available)
fonts.variable_fetch_pattern: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/<id>:vf@latest/<subset>-<axis|'full'>-<normal|italic>.woff2  (variable files are woff2 only; 'full' includes every axis, 'wght' just weight). Chromium's FontFace accepts woff2, so this works in the Playwright render.
fonts.variable_ttf_fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/<familynolowercasespaces>/<FamilyName>[<AXES,comma-separated>].ttf  (URL-encode [ ] as %5B %5D; e.g. ofl/fraunces/Fraunces%5BSOFT,WONK,opsz,wght%5D.ttf). Full glyph set, all axes, TTF. Exact filename varies: list with https://api.github.com/repos/google/fonts/contents/ofl/<dir>.
fonts.metadata_api: https://api.fontsource.org/v1/fonts/<id> (weights, styles, subsets, license) and https://api.fontsource.org/v1/variable/<id> (axes with min/max). No key needed.
fonts.usage: const f = new FontFace('Fraunces', `url(${path}) format('truetype')`, {weight:'900'}); await f.load(); document.fonts.add(f); await document.fonts.ready before the first seek.

verified_examples.result: 36/36 returned 200 font/ttf and all contain æøåÆØÅ (fontTools cmap check)

gotchas: Static Fontsource TTFs carry odd internal name tables (space-grotesk 700 reports family 'Space Grotesk Light'). Always set family and weight explicitly in FontFace and never rely on the internal name.
OFL allows bundling fonts in a repo and embedding them in commercial videos; just keep OFL.txt next to vendored files and do not sell the font files alone.
Honk and Nabla are COLRv1 color fonts: they render in Chromium, but fillStyle does not recolor them; use font-palette / @font-palette-values.
Permanent Marker is Apache-2.0, not OFL; both are fine.

photos_video.notes: Key required (free). Cannot sell unaltered images; cannot compile images to replicate a similar/competing service. API guideline wants hotlinked URLs, but for a video render you download once, trigger the download endpoint, and record photographer credit. Unsplash+ images are NOT under the free license: filter out premium results (plus=true).

Header 'Authorization: <API_KEY>'. 200 req/h, 20,000 req/month default. Video results include video_files[] with direct mp4 links at several resolutions, so frames can be extracted with ffmpeg.
photos_video.verified: yes: 401 application/json; charset=utf-8 (10.11.2026); 401 without key confirms endpoint

lottie.name: lottie-web (player)
lottie.notes: Deterministic: anim = lottie.loadAnimation({container, renderer:'canvas'|'svg', loop:false, autoplay:false, animationData}); in window.seek(t): anim.goToAndStop(t * anim.frameRate, true). Use the ANIMATION's frameRate (the 'fr' field), not the output video fps; goToAndStop(t*1000, false) takes ms instead. Wait for the 'DOMLoaded' event before the first seek. For drawing into our own canvas use renderer 'canvas' with rendererSettings.context, or render SVG and drawImage a serialized snapshot. Avoid files with expressions that call random() or time-of-day, and embed images (no external assets).

lottie.name: dotlottie-web (alt player)
lottie.fetch: npm @lottiefiles/dotlottie-web@0.82.1 (WASM ThorVG renderer, draws straight to a <canvas>); seek with setFrame(frame)
lottie.notes: Plays .lottie (zipped) and .json. WASM load is async; await 'load' before seeking. Use when lottie-web is too slow on big files.

best_defaults.icons: Lucide (ISC) via lucide-static on jsDelivr; Phosphor for weights/duotone; Iconify API as universal fallback with SPDX filtering

best_defaults.emoji: Fluent Emoji (MIT, 3D PNG / flat SVG); Twemoji if flat SVG by codepoint is needed (CC BY, credit)
best_defaults.fonts: Fontsource CDN static TTF per weight; :vf woff2 or google/fonts raw TTF for variable axes
best_defaults.photos_video: Pexels API (photos + video, one key); Mixkit for no-key direct mp4 (check Free vs Restricted per clip)
best_defaults.textures: Poly Haven (CC0, no key) + code-generated seeded grain/noise
